   "subject": "EEBA",
   "number": "6404",
   "title": "Key Developments in Environmental, Social, and Governance Investing",
   "scheduleType": "Lecture",
   "credits": 2,
   "nuPath": [],
   "description": "Offers students a hands-on opportunity to research and compare environmental, social, governance, and non–ESG portfolios while hearing from industry experts along the way. Exposes students to how and why investors engage in ESG investing and how to analyze the performance and risk of such investing. Covers what rating firms are, what global financial resources are committed to ESG investing, the regulatory landscape, and the ongoing challenges that ESG investing poses.
